targets.expr:
(
  100 * (
    1 -
    (
      (
        sum by (job) (rate(http_server_request_duration_count{job=~"$service",k8s_cluster_name="$cluster",deployment_environment_name="$environment",http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[5m]))
        or on(job)
        (0 * sum by (job) (rate(http_server_request_duration_count{job=~"$service",k8s_cluster_name="$cluster",deployment_environment_name="$environment"}[5m])))
      )
      /
      sum by (job) (rate(http_server_request_duration_count{job=~"$service",k8s_cluster_name="$cluster",deployment_environment_name="$environment"}[5m]))
    )
  )
)
and on(job)
(sum by (job) (rate(http_server_request_duration_count{job=~"$service",k8s_cluster_name="$cluster",deployment_environment_name="$environment"}[5m])) > 0)

(
  100 *
  sum by (job) (rate(http_server_request_duration_bucket{job=~"$service",k8s_cluster_name="$cluster",deployment_environment_name="$environment",le="0.5"}[5m]))
  /
  sum by (job) (rate(http_server_request_duration_count{job=~"$service",k8s_cluster_name="$cluster",deployment_environment_name="$environment"}[5m]))
)
and on(job)
(sum by (job) (rate(http_server_request_duration_count{job=~"$service",k8s_cluster_name="$cluster",deployment_environment_name="$environment"}[5m])) > 0)

panels.description: 5-minute availability error-budget burn rate. Below 1 is within budget.

targets.expr:
(
  (
    (
      sum by (job) (rate(http_server_request_duration_count{job=~"$service",k8s_cluster_name="$cluster",deployment_environment_name="$environment",http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[5m]))
      or on(job)
      (0 * sum by (job) (rate(http_server_request_duration_count{job=~"$service",k8s_cluster_name="$cluster",deployment_environment_name="$environment"}[5m])))
    )
    /
    clamp_min(sum by (job) (rate(http_server_request_duration_count{job=~"$service",k8s_cluster_name="$cluster",deployment_environment_name="$environment"}[5m])), 0.000001)
  )
  / 0.01
)
and on(job)
(sum by (job) (rate(http_server_request_duration_count{job=~"$service",k8s_cluster_name="$cluster",deployment_environment_name="$environment"}[5m])) > 0)
